issue_body: This build adds Math.parseDuration(s: string): number, which turns a compact duration string into a total number of seconds. The units are h (one hour = 3600 seconds), m (one minute = 60 seconds), and s (one second), and parts are concatenated, so "1h30m" should be 5400, "90m" should be 5400, "2h" should be 7200, "45s" should be 45, "1h2m3s" should be 3723, and "0s" should be 0. Any whitespace is ignored. The totals are coming back wrong: anything with minutes comes back far too small - "30m" gives 180 instead of 1800. Please figure out what is going on and fix it so the totals are correct.
